verses.en: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
verses.pt: No ano terceiro de Ciro, rei da Pérsia, foi revelada uma palavra a Daniel, cujo nome se chama Beltessazar, uma palavra verdadeira concernente a um grande conflito; e ele entendeu esta palavra, e teve entendimento da visão.
verses.en_web: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, even a great warfare. He understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
verses.en_bbe: In the third year of Cyrus, king of Persia, a secret was unfolded to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, even a hard work: and he had knowledge of it, and the vision was clear to him.

verses.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
verses.pt: Naqueles dias eu, Daniel, estava pranteando por três semanas inteiras.
verses.en_web: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.
verses.en_bbe: In those days I, Daniel, gave myself up to grief for three full weeks.

verses.en: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
verses.pt: Nenhuma coisa desejável comi, nem carne nem vinho entraram na minha boca, nem me ungi com ungüento, até que se cumpriram as três semanas completas.
verses.en_web: I ate no pleasant bread. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.
verses.en_bbe: I had no pleasing food, no meat or wine came into my mouth, and I put no oil on my body till three full weeks were ended.

verses.en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;
verses.pt: No dia vinte e quatro do primeiro mês, estava eu à borda do grande rio, o Tigre;
verses.en_web: In the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel,
verses.en_bbe: And on the twenty-fourth day of the first month I was by the side of the great river;

verses.en: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
verses.pt: levantei os meus olhos, e olhei, e eis um homem vestido de linho e os seus lombos cingidos com ouro fino de Ufaz;
verses.en_web: I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose thighs were adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.
verses.en_bbe: And lifting up my eyes I saw the form of a man clothed in a linen robe, and round him there was a band of gold, of the best gold:

verses.en: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
verses.pt: o seu corpo era como o berilo, e o seu rosto como um relâmpago; os seus olhos eram como tochas de fogo, e os seus braços e os seus pés como o brilho de bronze polido; e a voz das suas palavras como a voz duma multidão.
verses.en_web: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His arms and his feet were like burnished brass. The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude.
verses.en_bbe: And his body was like the beryl, and his face had the look of a thunder-flame, and his eyes were like burning lights, and his arms and feet like the colour of polished brass, and the sound of his voice was like the sound of an army.

verses.en: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
verses.pt: Ora, só eu, Daniel, vi aquela visão; pois os homens que estavam comigo não a viram: não obstante, caiu sobre eles um grande temor, e fugiram para se esconder.
verses.en_web: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision; but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.
verses.en_bbe: And I, Daniel, was the only one who saw the vision, for the men who were with me did not see it; but a great shaking came on them and they went in flight to take cover.

verses.en: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
verses.pt: Fiquei pois eu só a contemplar a grande visão, e não ficou força em mim; desfigurou-se a feição do meu rosto, e não retive força alguma.
verses.en_web: So I was left alone, and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
verses.en_bbe: So I was by myself, and I saw this great vision, and all my strength went from me; and the colour went from my face.

verses.en: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
verses.pt: Contudo, ouvi a voz das suas palavras; e, ouvindo o som das suas palavras, eu caí num profundo sono, com o rosto em terra.
verses.en_web: Yet I heard the voice of his words. When I heard the voice of his words, then I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.
verses.en_bbe: But the sound of his words came to my ears, and on hearing his voice I went into a deep sleep with my face to the earth.

verses.en: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
verses.pt: E eis que uma mão me tocou, e fez com que me levantasse, tremendo, sobre os meus joelhos e sobre as palmas das minhas mãos.
verses.en_web: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.
verses.en_bbe: Then a hand gave me a touch, awaking me, and putting me on my knees and my hands.

verses.en: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
verses.pt: E me disse: Daniel, homem muito amado, entende as palavras que te vou dizer, e levanta-te sobre os teus pés; pois agora te sou enviado. Ao falar ele comigo esta palavra, pus-me em pé tremendo.
verses.en_web: He said to me, Daniel, you greatly beloved man, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright; for I have been sent to you, now. When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, O Daniel, you man dearly loved, take in the sense of the words I say to you and get up on to your feet: for to you I am now sent; and when he had said this to me I got on to my feet, shaking with fear.

verses.en: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.
verses.pt: Então me disse: Não temas, Daniel; porque desde o primeiro dia em que aplicaste o teu coração a compreender e a humilhar-te perante o teu Deus, são ouvidas as tuas palavras, e por causa das tuas palavras eu vim.
verses.en_web: Then he said to me, “Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard. I have come for your words’ sake.
verses.en_bbe: Then he said to me, Have no fear, Daniel; for from the first day when you gave your heart to getting wisdom and making yourself poor in spirit before your God, your words have come to his ears: and I have come because of your words.

verses.en: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
verses.pt: Mas o príncipe do reino da Pérsia me resistiu por vinte e um dias; e eis que Miguel, um dos primeiros príncipes, veio para ajudar- me, e eu o deixei ali com os reis da Pérsia.
verses.en_web: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me because I remained there with the kings of Persia.
verses.en_bbe: But the angel of the kingdom of Persia put himself against me for twenty-one days; but Michael, one of the chief angels, came to my help; and when I came he was still there with the angel of the kings of Persia.

verses.en: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.
verses.pt: Agora vim, para fazer-te entender o que há de suceder ao teu povo nos derradeiros dias; pois a visão se refere a dias ainda distantes.
verses.en_web: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days; for the vision is yet for many days.”
verses.en_bbe: Now I have come to give you knowledge of the fate of your people in the later days; for there is still a vision for the days.

verses.en: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
verses.pt: Ao falar ele comigo estas palavras, abaixei o rosto para a terra e emudeci.
verses.en_web: When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground, and was mute.
verses.en_bbe: And after he had said these words to me, I kept my face turned to the earth and was unable to say anything.

verses.en: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
verses.pt: E eis que um que tinha a semelhança dos filhos dos homens me tocou os lábios; então abri a boca e falei, e disse àquele que estava em pé diante de mim: Senhor meu, por causa da visão sobrevieram-me dores, e não retenho força alguma.
verses.en_web: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, “My lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows have overtaken me, and I retain no strength.
verses.en_bbe: Then one whose form was like the sons of men put his finger on my lips; and opening my mouth, I said to him who was before me, O my lord, because of the vision my pains have come on me, and I have no more strength.

verses.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
verses.pt: Como, pois, pode o servo do meu Senhor falar com o meu Senhor? pois, quanto a mim, desde agora não resta força em mim, nem fôlego ficou em mim.
verses.en_web: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me. There was no breath left in me.”
verses.en_bbe: For how may this servant of my lord have talk with my lord? for, as for me, straight away my strength went from me and there was no breath in my body.

verses.en: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
verses.pt: Então tornou a tocar-me um que tinha a semelhança dum homem, e me consolou.
verses.en_web: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me.
verses.en_bbe: Then again one having the form of a man put his hand on me and gave me strength.

verses.en: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
verses.pt: E disse: Não temas, homem muito amado; paz seja contigo; sê forte, e tem bom ânimo. E quando ele falou comigo, fiquei fortalecido, e disse: Fala, meu senhor, pois me fortaleceste.
verses.en_web: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, O man greatly loved, have no fear: peace be with you, be strong and let your heart be lifted up. And at his words I became strong, and said, Let my lord say on, for you have given me strength.

verses.en: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
verses.pt: Ainda disse ele: Sabes por que eu vim a ti? Agora tornarei a pelejar contra o príncipe dos persas; e, saindo eu, eis que virá o príncipe da Grécia.
verses.en_web: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go out, behold, the prince of Greece will come.
verses.en_bbe: Then he said, It is clear to you why I have come to you. And now I will give you an account of what is recorded in the true writings:

verses.en: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.
verses.pt: Contudo eu te declararei o que está gravado na escritura da verdade; e ninguém há que se esforce comigo contra aqueles, senão Miguel, vosso príncipe.
verses.en_web: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth. There is no one who holds with me against these, but Michael your prince.
verses.en_bbe: But I am going back to make war with the angel of Persia, and when I am gone, the angel of Greece will come. And there is no one on my side against these, but Michael, your angel.
